I replied to Hollis in their DM to confirm the note: their Marrow Fieldworks pickups now go through Dock 14, and I'll keep that between us.

I didn't take any other action, since they said none was needed. I didn't save it to gbrain, because that's the shared workspace brain and other people could see it there. I didn't put it in my own memory either, where it could come up in other conversations. The note stays in this DM, where Hollis can look it up later.
